HEATING_NOTE_EN.供暖线以南却冬季湿冷，且无集中供暖（取暖靠自备）: South of the heating line: damp cold winters without district heating (self-heated).
HEATING_NOTE_EN.供暖线以南，冬季温暖、基本无需供暖: South of the heating line: mild winters, heating rarely needed.

HEATING_NOTE_EN.跨供暖线，淮河以北部分城市有集中供暖: Straddles the heating line: some cities north of the Huai have district heating.

HEADLINE_EN.沿海台风+城市内涝；缓发地面沉降: Coastal typhoons + urban flooding; slow land subsidence
HEADLINE_EN.多震带+干湿季地质灾害与季节性干旱: Multi-fault seismicity + seasonal geohazards and drought
HEADLINE_EN.华北平原旱涝+冬季暴雪；地震风险低于唐山带: N. China Plain drought/flood + winter blizzards; lower quake risk than Tangshan belt
HEADLINE_EN.夏汛、暴雪与西部干旱；地震少: Summer floods, blizzards, western drought; few quakes
HEADLINE_EN.华北平原旱涝+滨海风暴潮/海冰；唐山强震带波及: N. China Plain drought/flood + coastal storm surge/sea ice; Tangshan belt influence
HEADLINE_EN.江淮梅雨洪涝为最大风险: Yangtze–Huai Meiyu flooding is the top risk
HEADLINE_EN.旱涝+北上台风影响沿海: Drought/flood + north-tracking typhoons affect the coast
HEADLINE_EN.台风+流域性洪涝的双高暴露: Dual high exposure: typhoons + basin flooding
HEADLINE_EN.华北强震带(数十年一遇)+旱涝交替: N. China strong-quake belt (decadal) + drought/flood alternation
HEADLINE_EN.暴雨洪涝突出，旱涝并存: Heavy-rain flooding prominent; drought and flood coexist
HEADLINE_EN.台风暴雨+梅雨洪涝；沿海风暴潮: Typhoon rains + Meiyu floods; coastal storm surge
HEADLINE_EN.全国台风登陆最前沿: Front line of typhoon landfalls nationwide
HEADLINE_EN.长江流域洪涝突出，伏旱与高温并存: Yangtze basin floods prominent; summer drought and heat coexist
HEADLINE_EN.强震+半干旱区旱灾与黄土滑坡: Strong quakes + semi-arid drought and loess landslides
HEADLINE_EN.喀斯特地质灾害突出，冬季凝冻为特色风险: Karst geohazards prominent; winter freezing rain a signature risk
HEADLINE_EN.夏汛+北上台风外围，海城式中强震(数十年一遇): Summer floods + north-tracking typhoon bands; Haicheng-class moderate quakes (decadal)
HEADLINE_EN.高温伏旱+山地滑坡+江河洪涝: Summer heat drought + mountain slides + river floods
HEADLINE_EN.夏汛+冬季暴雪为主；无台风、地震少: Summer floods + winter blizzards dominate; few typhoons/quakes
